text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to see and understand the world through images and videos. One of its core tasks is image recognition, which means identifying what is in a picture, such as a cat or a tree. Another important task is object detection, where the computer not only names objects but also locates them with boxes or outlines. These technologies have many practical applications. For example, in self-driving cars, computer vision helps the vehicle recognize traffic lights, pedestrians, and other cars, allowing it to make safe driving decisions. It is also used in facial recognition for phone security, medical imaging to help doctors spot diseases, and retail systems to track inventory. As this technology improves, our devices will become even smarter and more helpful in daily life.
